name: cron
algorithm: Run the cron dogfood's scheduler over its bench crontab (four jobs in three time zones) under std.sim's simulated clock for a number of days, with its lock and log on the simulation's disk, then print the fires a time-zone transition moved and the summary by job (README.md).
notes: Tier A (M9 item 11.32): an Mk-only row, the cron dogfood unchanged (its bin cron), compared across mk binaries; no twin, no peer, no defect line (README.md).

The crontab is the dogfood's own (Dogfoods/cron/cases/data/busy.tab), named through {pkg}. The quick arguments are the dogfood's bench case (365 days, sim's default); the publish arguments run 3,660 days, sim's largest.
The size is provisional; tools/bench verify -publish-size fixes it in the quiet window, and the checksum changes with it.
